name: zeroplay-debrid
description: ZeroPlay keyless discovery and playback — single-file site + serverless functions.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/index.html && mkdir -p dist/vendor && cp vendor/hls.min.js vendor/dash.min.js dist/vendor/ && echo ZeroPlay static build complete
scripts.test: node tests/discovery-identity.test.cjs && node tests/crawler.test.cjs && node tests/regressions.test.cjs && node tests/tv-player.test.cjs && node tests/android-tv-ui.test.cjs && node tests/downloads-m3u.test.cjs && node tests/home-navigation.test.cjs && node tests/tv-navigation-contract.test.cjs && node tests/settings-sections.test.cjs
